sum_insured_options: ₹5L – ₹20L (based on sub-limit table; exact range not fully specified)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. If 'Cashless Discount' optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, kidney, liver, infectious conditions.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible in base plan. Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10k–₹3L available as optional discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required for PED. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, arthroplasty, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional Super Cumulative Bonus available (25%/yr up to 100% or 200%, or 50%/yr up to 100%).

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap (waived for different insured person).

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of 399+ procedures provided. Any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI but excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, arthritis, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, vector-borne diseases, and several others. Must exceed 3 days.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to In-patient SI. Requires minimum 24-hour admission. Comfort treatments (steam bath, sauna, oil massage) excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Reinstatement benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI. Covers transfer to nearest hospital and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections, etc. Cumulative bonus and reinstatement not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables during hospitalisation are covered as part of in-patient treatment, but standalone consumable rider not offered.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly premium mode.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period at inception only; not applicable at renewal or porting.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, overseas treatment, external congenital anomalies, growth hormone therapy, non-AYUSH alternative systems, domiciliary for diabetes/hypertension/asthma

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus, Disease Sub-limits (discount), Cashless Discount (20% co-pay on reimbursement), Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount
